newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Early Swedish shares perky, Ericsson catches up.
newsitem.headline: Early Swedish shares perky, Ericsson catches up.

text.p: Swedish shares edged up in early Friday trade with Ericsson pulling ahead of its New York close as some operators covered short positions opened after it corrected down on Thursday, brokers said.
At 0855 GMT the general index had risen 0.39 percent to 3,118.58. Ericsson was up 2.5 crowns to 320, above its New York closing price. "Why not cover and end the week flat?" said one broker.
Drug company Astra rose one crown to 151.5 after having risen about 1.5 crowns above its Stockholm closing price overnight. Forestry shares rose, the index up 1.05 percent.
But overall, one broker said the market was extremely sleepy following a relatively brisk pre-open.
"It's so quiet, you can hear the bonuses falling," he said.
